title: Power Max
author: 安家慶
desc: This programs focuses on 6 main lifts while still providing enough hypertrophy to light up a house. For lower body movements it alternates between deadlifts and squats because of the overlapping muscle groups while still keeping skill practice high with reps. As for the secondary movements progress them after every deload, 5-10kg on bigger more compound movements, 2.5-5 on the isolation exercises. Whilst in the training phase if a secondary movement becomes to easy add reps instead of weight to progress it.
